players.detail: Left the Aug. 21 preseason game with a knee issue on special teams. Cisse said afterward it was 'nothing serious' and that he was held out as a precaution; no practice return has been confirmed yet.
Suffered a calf issue during pregame warmups Aug. 21 and did not play against Denver. No return timetable has been confirmed.

Left the Aug. 21 preseason game and was evaluated after the play. Reporting noted a possible concussion evaluation, but no diagnosis has been confirmed, so he remains a monitor case pending a team update.
Sustained an ankle issue during the Aug. 21 preseason game and was limited to two offensive snaps. No return timetable has been confirmed.
Played a limited number of snaps against Denver while dealing with a calf issue. No setback or return-to-full-work timeline has been confirmed.
Remained sidelined through the Aug. 20 walkthrough. Current camp reporting says he is expected back soon; no return has been confirmed yet.
Remained sidelined through the Aug. 20 walkthrough after leaving the preseason opener. Current camp reporting says he is expected back soon, but no return has been confirmed yet.
Continues to receive team work during his managed return from a knee injury. No new setback has been reported.
Remained on the PUP list through the latest confirmed practice reporting; no activation has been reported.
Remained on PUP through the latest confirmed practice reporting while recovering from a lower-body injury.
Remained on PUP through the latest confirmed camp reporting with a calf issue.
Remained on the PUP list through the latest confirmed practice reporting with a neck issue.

Returned to practice Aug. 18 after missing the Aug. 16 practice with a shoulder issue.
Returned to practice Aug. 16 after leaving the preseason opener with an injury.
